summary: Estimate Workbench v1.1 (6-phase refinement) frontend testing complete. 15/15 review-request features PASS. iteration_32's HIGH bug (estimate number overwritten on first save) is RESOLVED — code now uses `estNumber = (estimateNumber && estimateNumber.trim()) ? estimateNumber : generateEstimateNumber()`. Verified end-to-end: seeded company profile → new estimate loads defaults (markup=15/cont=10/gst=5/estimator/valid_until=today+30) → expanded Finish Carpentry → added 3 items which auto-populated Unit (SF/EA) + Unit Price from standard_rate ($8, $35, $7) → switched Pricing Profile to Premium mid-estimate and added Door Extension Jamb which correctly picked $50 premium rate (existing items kept their snapshot prices — immutable snapshot verified) → summary math validated ($50 → subtotal, +7.50 markup 15%, +5.75 cont 10%, +3.16 tax 5% = $66.41 total) → edited Wood Slat Wall price to $99.99, unit_price_override flag stored + amber AlertCircle rendered → saved to localStorage with full metadata (client_info, project_info, company_profile_snapshot, pricing_profile, pricing_profile_at_add per line item, snapshot with low_rate/standard_rate/premium_rate) → reload via ?id={uuid} restored every field including user-typed estimate_number `TEST-PHASE11-001` (bug fixed) → PDF export downloaded 12.9 KB, 2 pages, contained all sections: company logo/name, ESTIMATE title, Estimate #, Date, Valid Until, FROM, TO/Attn, Project name, PREMIUM RATES badge, prepared by, 8-col line item table grouped with subtotal, Pricing Summary (Subtotal/Markup/Contingency/GST/Total), Notes, Clarifications & Qualifications, Terms & Conditions on page 2, Signature area (Signature/Date/Print Name/Title), Page numbers. One MINOR bug: page 1 footer prints duplicated text `TEST Two Fungis Page 1TEST Two Fungis Page 1 of 2`.

ui_bugs.issue: PDF page 1 footer renders duplicated text: 'TEST Two Fungis Page 1TEST Two Fungis Page 1 of 2'. Looks like the footer is drawn twice on page 1 (or the intermediate 'Page N' string is not cleared before 'Page N of M' overprints). Page 2 footer is clean: 'TEST Two Fungis Page 2 of 2'. Suspect the first pass writes 'Page N' immediately and then a second finalization pass writes 'Page N of M' at the same x-position without clearing.

critical_code_review_comments: EstimateWorkbench.jsx is now 1226 lines (was 1179 in iteration_32). File continues to exceed the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting <HeaderEditor/>, <EstimateSelector/> and the calculations useMemo/save/load helpers into separate modules.

COMPANY_PROFILE_KEY and loadCompanyProfile() are still duplicated between EstimateWorkbench.jsx (lines 62–73) and CompanyProfile.jsx — extract to a shared /utils/companyProfile.js. Drift risk increases as Phase 5/6 add more consumers.

LiveSummary.jsx (line 40-62) re-computes the same subtotal/markup/contingency/tax math that EstimateWorkbench.jsx already computes in `calculations` useMemo (line 562-583). Pass `calculations` as a prop to LiveSummary (single source of truth). Same computation is also inlined in saveEstimate() (line 302-308) — 3 duplicate implementations.

EstimateWorkbench.jsx handleAddItem pricing selection (line 469-488) hardcodes the fallback chain. Consider centralizing this into a `resolveUnitPriceForProfile(standard, profile)` helper. Also, `low_labour_rate` is used as both the Low tier AND as a fallback for Standard (line 481) — this can produce misleading rates when a standard only has low_labour_rate set. Recommend requiring standard_rate to be set explicitly and displaying '—' when the selected tier is 0.

unit_price_override tracking is one-way: once user overrides, changing pricingProfile does NOT clear/reset the override. This is likely intended (immutable) but not documented. Consider adding a 'Reset to library' button per line item that clears unit_price_override and re-reads from snapshot[selectedProfile]_rate.
estimatePdfGenerator.js is 705 lines (exactly on the 700-line boundary). Consider breaking into logical modules: header/logo, client/project block, table renderer, summary, terms, signature, footer.
EstimateWorkbench.jsx still uses browser confirm() in createNewEstimate + handleClearEstimate (carry-over from iteration_31/32). Prefer a shadcn AlertDialog.
Save writes to localStorage but no throttling/debounce → repeated Save clicks in <500ms could race. Low priority since UI shows isSaving spinner.
handleUpdateItem shows toast.success('Item updated') on EVERY keystroke-committed edit → noisy. Consider debouncing or only toasting on the batch save.

rca of the issue: PDF page-1 footer duplication: pdftotext extract shows literal string 'TEST Two Fungis Page 1TEST Two Fungis Page 1 of 2' on page 1, while page 2 shows a clean 'TEST Two Fungis Page 2 of 2'. Root cause is likely a two-pass footer render in estimatePdfGenerator.js: pass 1 writes 'Page N' during each page's generation, then pass 2 writes 'Page N of totalPages' after knowing totalPages, but on page 1 both writes overlap at the same x/y without clearing. Fix: (a) defer the footer draw until totalPages is known (single-pass at the end using pdf.setPage()) OR (b) draw the footer white rectangle to clear before overprinting. Reproduction: any estimate that spans ≥2 pages (achievable by any estimate with clarifications + terms so page 2 has content) will show the artifact on page 1.
